title: AFP says it was the target of a cyberattack; AFP Forum platform isolated and temporarily inaccessible
geo_basis: AFP's dateline is Paris; the page does not name a headquarters city
summary: AFP said in an internal management message, as relayed by the agency, that it was the target of a cyberattack overnight from Wednesday to Thursday, starting at 01:30 Paris time. Its teams isolated the AFP Forum platform on detecting the intrusion, and it remains temporarily inaccessible as a precaution. AFP says it has no information on who carried out the attack. RIA Novosti adds that AFP said the incident is being analyzed with outside experts.
plain: The news agency AFP says it was hit by a cyberattack overnight and cut off its AFP Forum platform as a precaution. It says it does not know who is behind it.
exec: A major news agency took a client content platform offline after an intrusion; AFP says it offered alternative solutions to clients.

evidence.quote: La AFP fue blanco de un ciberataque esta noche [del miércoles a jueves], a partir de la 01H30 [hora de París].

validation.note: Unitel (AFP wire, Spanish) and RIA Novosti (Russian) each state AFP's message that it was the target of a cyberattack from 01:30 Paris time and that AFP Forum was isolated; both relay AFP's own statement.

review.note: compared 01:30 Paris time, AFP Forum isolated, no attacker info, alternative solutions, outside experts against Unitel and RIA
